title: Nine Miles of Watching
subtitle: 云与天空 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 云与天空（自然生态·天空与气象）
meta: 主题语境：云与天空（自然生态·天空与气象）　|　核心词汇：cloud　|　正文 333 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cloud 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1944 my mother was sent to watch ① cloud she could not name, and she said the watching was the whole of the lesson. The ② cloud, meaning the vapour and not the storm, was nine miles high and was watched by whoever came last; cloud, she said, is the only thing in a sky that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ cloud in that sky had the same edge, and the ④ cloud at the end, meaning the one the shepherd kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever watched properly. Cloud, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ cloud was the whole of the afternoon, meaning the shadow it carried and not the vapour. The ⑥ cloud, meaning the shadow and not any of that, is the only thing in an afternoon that everybody welcomes and nobody questions; cloud, he said, is either something you watch or the only word that means both vapour and a shadow. She said the shadow is the part they remember.

By 1959 the ⑦ cloud had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the edge. The ⑧ cloud of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine miles and eleven years of watching; cloud, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ cloud I remember is the one at the end, which was watched in 1964 and is still described as the whitest in the county. A ⑩ cloud, my grandmother said in 1969, is the only thing that improves by being watched; every cloud, she said, is a shadow that has agreed to look like vapour. She said the shadow was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 云（指那团水汽本身，与那场暴雨相对）
C. 固定搭配：watch a cloud 观察一朵云
D. n. 云（指那片天空里每一朵）
E. n. 云（指末尾那一朵）
F. n. 荫凉（抽象：它投下的那片阴影）
G. n. 那片阴影（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The cloud, meaning the vapour and not the storm
cloud was the whole of the afternoon
the cloud had become a number in a report
The cloud of the whole thing
A cloud, my grandmother said in 1969

answers.why: watch a cloud 意为“观察一朵云”，1944 年母亲被派去观察她叫不出名字的那朵云。
cloud 意为“云、云朵”，指那团水汽本身而不是那场暴雨，高九英里，由最后来的人观察。
cloud 指那片天空里每一朵云，每一朵都是同样的边。
cloud 指末尾那一朵（牧羊人认得的那朵），是唯一有人认真观察过的。
cloud 意为“荫凉”，抽象指它投下的那片阴影，父亲说 cloud 就是那个下午的全部。
cloud 为抽象用法，指那片阴影本身，是一个下午里人人都欢迎、却没人质疑的东西。
cloud 意为“云、云朵”，到 1959 年这朵 cloud 成了报告里的一个数字。
cloud 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英里和十一年的观察。
cloud 意为“云”，我记得的是末尾那一朵，1964 年观察过，至今仍被说成全县最白的。
cloud 为抽象总称，祖母说一朵云是唯一会因为被认真观察而变好的东西。
